honest_gaps: The cortical-route ('high road') exact latency in milliseconds is NOT verbatim-quoted in any abstract fetched live this session. Li, Stutzmann & LeDoux 1996 (PMID 10456093) states only the qualitative ordering ('rapid... thalamus' vs 'slower... cortex'); a live elink check this session confirmed that paper has NO PMC full-text deposit (only reverse-citation links via pubmed_pmc_refs), so the primary numeric value (if published in-text/in-table rather than in the abstract) was not reachable this session. The script's cortical-thalamic gap ceiling (200ms) is explicitly disclosed as an UNPINNED, deliberately generous (conservative-against-the-hypothesis) order-of-magnitude bound, not an independently-sourced citation.

A genuine literature TENSION, forced and disclosed, not hidden: Weisskopf, Bauer & LeDoux 1999 (PMID 10575047) found thalamo-amygdala LTP recorded in vitro is itself NMDA-INDEPENDENT (L-type voltage-gated Ca-channel dependent), despite NMDA receptors being present and pathway-specific at that exact synapse (Weisskopf & LeDoux 1999, PMID 10036290). This means the 'NMDA receptor = the coincidence detector at the thalamic synapse' story (Li et al 1996's own stated hypothesis, which this doc's Part 1 builds on) is a PROPOSED, plausible mechanism, not a fully closed/uncontested one; Miserendino et al 1990's behavioral NMDA-block finding may be substantially mediated by OTHER LA synapses (e.g. cortical input, or postsynaptic integration broadly) rather than specifically the thalamic-input LTP mechanism Weisskopf isolated in vitro.

The savings-headstart robustness sweep (Part 4) CAUGHT a real artifact in this script's own first version: the integer trials-to-criterion metric FAILED to show savings at 2/7 head-start fractions (0.05, 0.1) -- not because savings was absent, but because a coarse integer-trial discretization can mask a small continuous effect. Diagnosed (the underlying recurrence is an affine contraction that provably preserves ordering for all t) and fixed with a continuous monotonicity measure, which is robust across all 7/7 sweep points. Disclosed as a genuine catch, not smoothed over -- see the script's own inline comment trail.

Bouton & King 1983's own Experiment 4 found NO renewal in a specific reversed-context-order arrangement (extinguish in the original conditioning context, then test in a novel second context) -- renewal is NOT simply 'any context switch,' it has a real, order-dependent structure this script's toy renewal gate (a binary in-extinction-context vs not) does not capture. Disclosed as an unmodeled asymmetry, not claimed to be resolved.

Human lesion evidence for the amygdala-necessity claim rests on genuinely small samples: Bechara et al 1995's triple dissociation is 3 patients (1 amygdala-only, 1 hippocampus-only, 1 both); the patient S.M. lineage (Urbach-Wiethe disease, congenital bilateral amygdala calcification, lifelong compensation) is not equivalent to an acute adult lesion. LaBar et al 1995's unilateral-lobectomy cohort is larger but still a clinical (not experimental) lesion population. Disclosed, not smoothed into a false population-level precision.

The PTSD gate-efficacy parameters (g_normal=0.85, g_ptsd=0.35) are ILLUSTRATIVE contrasts chosen to reproduce the DIRECTION of Milad et al 2009's measured day-2 dissociation (impaired recall in PTSD), not independently fit to a reported effect size -- that paper's own abstract does not give an exact SCR-ratio or percentage-difference number extractable without further digging into its full text (not attempted this session, disclosed).

The associative-learning-gate's rate constant (eta=0.35) is explicitly disclosed as FREE/uncalibrated -- the model's falsifiable content is the qualitative SHAPE (monotonic, saturating) and the STRUCTURAL zero-floor/lesion/NMDA-block properties, not a fitted numeric prediction of any specific trial-by-trial freezing percentage. No primary source with an explicit number-of-pairings-vs-percent-CR empirical curve was pinned down live this session (searched; Quirk 2002's 7-pairing protocol and Quirk/Repa/LeDoux 1995's 'often within the first several trials' finding are the closest anchors found, both qualitative/protocol-level, not a full digitized curve) -- a genuine, disclosed gap, not fabricated.

Rescorla & Wagner (1972) -- the canonical delta-rule formalism this script's Part 2 instantiates -- is a book chapter (Black & Prokasy eds., Classical Conditioning II), confirmed live this session to have 0 PubMed hits (not journal-indexed). Cited as classic/theoretical tier, the same disclosed treatment this repo already gives equally foundational pre-indexed references (Bernheimer 1973, Nagatsu 1964 in MECHANISM_DOPAMINE_KINETICS_evidence.json).
